title: Recording: Captain Of Love by Wings | 1972
content:
Studio One, Trident Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: David Hentschel

Wings worked on the unreleased song ‘Captain Of Love’ on 21 November 1972.

The song was written by Denny Laine, but was unfinished at the time it was brought into the studio. Despite Paul McCartney encouraging his bandmates to contribute music of their own, it was abandoned after the following day’s session.
